# What main is known to fail, which the gate lets a change through on: one line each, the exact
# name, then ` | `, then the change that broke it, as a pull request (#1609) or a commit (a1b2c3d).
#
#   cli::a_release_built_anywhere_is_the_same_bytes | #1488
#   examples/fizzbuzz.fen | a8b1dec6d
#
# A test is named as `cargo test` names it; a program, as the examples and Rosetta steps do, by its
# path. Whoever fixes one takes its line out in the same change. Empty when main is green.
# Both end with blocks still live, which the examples steps fail on since live counts native
# blocks (#1629): dicts_large leaves 1, struct_keys_native leaves 4. The runtime lane is fixing it.
examples/dicts_large.fen | #1629
examples/struct_keys_native.fen | #1629
